title: 第0007章 暗夜截杀绝地反击第0008章 药徒六重林家惊变
content_zh:
【第一节：药会散场，暗流涌动】
青炎药会在一片喧嚣与震撼中缓缓落下帷幕。
夕阳西下，残阳如血，将青炎城染成了一片瑰丽的赤红。城主府广场上的人群逐渐散去，但关于今日药会的谈资，却如同瘟疫般在城市的各个角落蔓延开来。
“听说了吗？那个被除名的林家废柴，竟然在药会上大放异彩！”
“何止是大放异彩！人家炼制的‘强骨散’竟然是极品丹药，连铁家和王家的人都抢着要！”
“最绝的是苏家那位大小姐苏清雪，竟然主动和他私下交谈！林啸天少主当时的脸色，啧啧，比锅底还黑！”
街谈巷议之中，林药尘这三个字，第一次以一种并非“废物”、“笑柄”的方式，传遍了青炎城的大街小巷。
此时的城主府侧门，一辆装饰朴素的马车静静等候着。林药尘与苏清雪并肩走出府邸，夕阳的余晖洒在两人身上，拉长了他们的影子。
经过方才的交谈，两人之间的关系似乎缓和了不少，但那层看不见的隔阂依然存在。苏清雪身负家族使命，林药尘心怀血海深仇，他们注定无法回到从前。
“今日之言，还望林公子谨记。”苏清雪停下脚步，转过身来，清冷的眸子看着林药尘，语气中带着一丝不易察觉的关切，“林家势大，如今又正值多事之秋，你虽在药道上展露头角，但武道修为终究是短板。若无必要，这几日切莫单独出城。”
林药尘心中一暖，知道这是苏清雪在暗中提醒他。他微微一笑，抱拳道：“多谢苏姑娘提醒。林某不是不知进退之人，心中有数。”
苏清雪点了点头，不再多言，在侍女的簇拥下登上马车，绝尘而去。
林药尘看着马车远去的方向，目光逐渐变得冷冽。
“林啸天，你今日在台上那副要吃人的模样，我都看在眼里。”林药尘低声自语，嘴角勾起一抹冷冽的弧度，“你以为找几个杀手就能解决我吗？呵呵，正好，我也缺个立威的对象。”
他并没有回“惠民草堂”，而是故意在城中绕了几圈，买了一匹耐力不错的枣红马，又采购了一批炼药所需的辅料和干粮，随后大摇大摆地出了南城门。
他故意放慢了速度，甚至没有收敛自己的气息。因为他知道，林啸天绝不会让他平安度过今晚。与其被动防守，不如主动设局，将那些尾巴一网打尽！
【第二节：荒野截杀，黑衣现身】
南下的官道，由于天色已晚，行人稀少。道路两旁是茂密的树林，不时传来几声凄厉的鸦啼，更添几分阴森。
林药尘骑在马上，看似悠闲，实则精神高度集中。体内的《万古药尊诀》缓缓运转，药徒四重的真气遍布全身，感知如同蛛网般向四周扩散。
走出城门约二十里，来到一处名为“黑风岭”的地段。这里地势险要，两侧山崖高耸，中间只有一条狭窄的通道，是标准的“一线天”地形，也是最理想的杀人越货之地。

“果然来了。”林药尘勒住马缰，嘴角泛起一丝冷笑。
四周的树林中，突然传出一阵窸窸窣窣的声音。紧接着，十几道黑影如同鬼魅般从树冠、岩石后飘然而下，手中寒光闪闪的利刃，在夕阳下折射出令人胆寒的光芒。
这些人动作矫健，气息阴冷，显然都是精锐的杀手。他们二话不说，迅速结成一个合围之势，将林药尘堵在了路口中央。
为首的是一个戴着青铜面具的黑衣人，他声音沙哑，如同两块砂纸摩擦：“小子，你不该得罪林少主。乖乖交出你身上的财物和丹方，留你全尸。”
林药尘坐在马上，居高临下地扫视了一圈这十几个杀手。淬体境的有六七个，剩下的竟然都是聚气境一二重！这样的阵容，用来杀一个“药徒四重”的少年，简直是杀鸡用牛刀。
“林啸天还真是看得起我啊。”林药尘叹了口气，摇了摇头，“为了杀我，竟然派出了聚气境的杀手。看来林少主是真的不想让我活着走出这黑风岭了。”
“少废话！死！”青铜面具人显然不想多费唇舌，大手一挥，十几个杀手同时发动攻击！
刀光剑影瞬间笼罩了林药尘，杀气凛然，仿佛要将这片空间撕裂！
【第三节：药武合璧，初试锋芒】
面对十几名高手的围攻，林药尘神色不变，甚至没有立刻拔剑。
“以为人多就能赢我吗？”林药尘冷笑一声，体内真气疯狂运转，双手迅速结印。
“仙灵脾——强骨散，激发！”
他猛地从怀中掏出一瓶丹药，捏碎瓶口，将里面的丹药全部倒入嘴中。这是他在药会结束后紧急炼制的一批强骨散，药效比普通的强了数倍不止！
丹药入腹，瞬间化作一股狂暴的热流，涌入四肢百骸。林药尘只觉得肌肉暴涨，骨骼发出噼啪爆响，全身充满了爆炸性的力量！
“砰！”
一名淬体境的杀手挥刀劈来，林药尘竟然不闪不避，直接一拳轰在刀背上！
“咔嚓！”
精钢打造的长刀竟然应声而断！拳劲余势未减，狠狠轰在那名杀手的胸口，直接将他轰飞出去，撞在旁边的山壁上，吐血而亡！
一拳，秒杀淬体境！
这一幕，让周围攻上来的杀手们心中大骇。这小子不是药徒吗？怎么肉身力量如此恐怖？
content_en:
[Section 1: The medicinal meeting ends, undercurrent surges]
The Qingyan Medicine Club slowly came to an end amidst the noise and shock.
As the sun sets in the west, the setting sun is like blood, dyeing Qingyan City a magnificent red. The crowd in the square of the City Lord's Mansion gradually dispersed, but the talk about today's medicine meeting spread like a plague in every corner of the city.
"Have you heard? That good-for-nothing from the Lin family who was expelled actually made a splash at the medicine party!"
"It's more than just a show! The 'Strong Bone Powder' they refined turned out to be a top-quality elixir, and even people from the Tie family and the Wang family are rushing to get it!"
"The most amazing thing is that the eldest lady of the Su family, Su Qingxue, actually took the initiative to talk to him in private! Young Master Lin Xiaotian's face at that time, tsk tsk, was darker than the bottom of the pot!"
In the street talks, for the first time, the words Lin Yaochen spread throughout the streets and alleys of Qingyan City in a way that was not "waste" or "a laughingstock".
At this time, a plainly decorated carriage was waiting quietly at the side entrance of the City Lord's Mansion. Lin Yaochen and Su Qingxue walked out of the mansion side by side. The afterglow of the setting sun shone on the two of them, lengthening their shadows.
After the conversation just now, the relationship between the two seemed to have eased a lot, but the invisible barrier still existed. Su Qingxue has a family mission, and Lin Yaochen has a blood feud. They are destined to be unable to go back to the past.
"I hope Mr. Lin will remember what I said today." Su Qingxue stopped, turned around, and looked at Lin Yaochen with cold eyes, with a hint of concern in her voice. "The Lin family is powerful, and it is a troubled time now. Although you have shown your prominence in medicine, your martial arts cultivation is still weak. If it is not necessary, do not go out of the city alone these days."
Lin Yaochen felt warm in his heart, knowing that Su Qingxue was secretly reminding him. He smiled slightly, cupped his fists and said, "Thank you, Miss Su, for reminding me. Lin is not a person who doesn't know how to advance and retreat, and he knows what's going on."
Su Qingxue nodded, said no more, boarded the carriage surrounded by the maids, and left.
Lin Yaochen looked in the direction of the carriage, his eyes gradually becoming cold.
"Lin Xiaotian, I saw how you looked like you were going to eat people on stage today." Lin Yaochen whispered to himself, with a cold arc on the corner of his mouth, "Do you think you can kill me by finding a few killers? Haha, just in time, I also lack someone to establish my authority."
He did not return to the "Huimin Thatched Cottage", but deliberately walked around the city a few times, bought a bay-red horse with good endurance, and purchased a batch of supplementary materials and dry food needed for refining medicine, and then walked out of the South City Gate in a swagger.
He deliberately slowed down and didn't even control his breath. Because he knew that Lin Xiaotian would never let him spend tonight safely. Instead of passively defending, it is better to take the initiative to set up a trap and catch those tails in one fell swoop!
[Section 2: Interception in the wilderness, appearance in black]
On the official road going south, because it was getting late, there were few pedestrians. There are dense woods on both sides of the road, and from time to time there are screams of crows, adding to the gloom.
Lin Yaochen was riding a horse, seemingly leisurely, but in fact he was highly focused. The "Eternal Medicine Master Technique" in the body is slowly running, the fourth level of medicine apprentice's true energy is spread all over the body, and the senses are spreading around like a spider web.
About twenty miles out of the city gate, we came to an area called "Black Wind Ridge". The terrain here is dangerous, with towering cliffs on both sides, and only a narrow passage in the middle. It is a standard "line of sky" terrain, and it is also the most ideal place for killing people and stealing goods.
"Sure enough, he's here." Lin Yaochen reined in the horse with a sneer on his lips.
Suddenly there was a rustling sound in the surrounding woods. Immediately afterwards, more than a dozen black shadows floated down from the tree crowns and rocks like ghosts, and the cold and shining sharp blades in their hands reflected a frightening light in the setting sun.
These people have vigorous movements and cold breaths. They are obviously elite killers. Without saying a word, they quickly formed an encirclement and blocked Lin Yaochen in the middle of the intersection.The leader was a man in black wearing a bronze mask. His voice was hoarse, like two pieces of sandpaper rubbing against each other: "Boy, you shouldn't offend Young Master Lin. Obediently hand over your belongings and elixirs, and leave your body intact."
Lin Yaochen sat on the horse and glanced condescendingly at the dozen killers. There are six or seven in the Body Tempering Realm, and the rest are actually at the first or second level of the Qi Gathering Realm! Such a lineup, used to kill a "fourth level medicine apprentice" boy, is simply killing a chicken with a sledgehammer.
"Lin Xiaotian really thinks highly of me." Lin Yaochen sighed and shook his head, "In order to kill me, he actually sent out killers from the Qi Gathering Realm. It seems that Young Master Lin really doesn't want me to get out of this Black Wind Ridge alive."
"Stop talking nonsense! Die!" The bronze masked man obviously didn't want to waste any more words. With a wave of his hand, more than a dozen killers attacked at the same time!
The sword light and sword shadow instantly enveloped Lin Yaochen, with murderous intent, as if he was going to tear this space apart!
[Section 3: The combination of medicine and martial arts, the first test of edge]
Faced with the siege of more than a dozen masters, Lin Yaochen's expression remained unchanged and he did not even draw his sword immediately.
"Do you think you can win against me if you have more people?" Lin Yaochen sneered, the energy in his body was running wildly, and he quickly formed seals with his hands.
"Fairy Spirit Spleen-Strengthening Bone Powder, stimulate!"
He suddenly took out a bottle of elixir from his arms, crushed the mouth of the bottle, and poured all the elixir inside into his mouth. This is a batch of bone-strengthening powder that he made urgently after the medicine meeting. The effect of the medicine is several times stronger than ordinary ones!
The elixir entered his stomach and instantly turned into a violent heat flow, pouring into his limbs and bones. Lin Yaochen only felt his muscles swelling, his bones crackling and exploding, and his whole body was filled with explosive power!
"Bang!"
A killer in the Body Tempering Realm slashed at him with a sword, but Lin Yaochen didn't even dodge, and directly punched the back of the sword!
"Crack!"
The long knife made of fine steel broke at the sound! The strength of the fist remained unabated, and it hit the killer's chest hard, sending him flying directly, hitting the mountain wall next to him, and he vomited blood and died!
One punch, killing the body quenching realm instantly!
This scene shocked the surrounding killers. Isn't this guy a medicine man? Why is the physical power so terrifying?
